cases.prompt: Use static-graphic-design-creator. /codes. Show the full catalog in English.
expected_observables: All 200 canonical entries in 20 groups with descriptions and attribution
Equivalent /kody, kody and codes variants respect requested language

cases.prompt: Use static-graphic-design-creator. Return only an English prompt for a new square digital graphic using /Two Ink Collision. Approved concept: the word is the entire image, with generous surrounding space. Exact final text: CZYTAJ. Use navy and orange inks on cream paper.
expected_observables: Standalone prompt, instruction-only identifier and concrete two-ink logic
Exact final text preserved
must_not: Claim of a native generator command

cases.prompt: Use static-graphic-design-creator. Inspect the attached poster and return a complete redesign prompt using /Two Ink Collision /rebuild. Rework layout and colour, preserve all factual text and protected logos exactly, and keep the existing concept. Ask about unreadable mandatory text before finalizing.
expected_observables: Actual supplied image inspected
Complete factual inventory and protected assets
Broad layout change limited to requested scope

cases.prompt: Use static-graphic-design-creator. Return only an English prompt for a square graphic. Approved concept: a single word forms the image with wide empty margins. Exact final text: CZYTAJ. I want navy and orange matte inks on cream paper with restrained overprinting. Choose the execution from this brief.
expected_observables: Brief-led visual choices; internal catalog choice only if useful
Complete prompt in ordinary design language
must_not: Code labels, names or EP IDs in the answer

cases.prompt: Use static-graphic-design-creator. Return only an English prompt for a new square graphic using /Two Ink Collision. Do not show codes or their names. Approved concept: one forceful inscription with local two-ink overprint. Navy and orange on cream. Exact final text: RUCH/2026.
expected_observables: Direction translated without identifiers
RUCH/2026 preserved exactly including the slash
must_not: Code name or EP ID leak

cases.prompt: Use static-graphic-design-creator. Do not use the catalog, even internally. Return only an English prompt for a vertical 4:5 digital graphic. Approved concept and final copy: CISZA in slender black letters in the lower third on a uniform white field; the rest is empty. No textures or illustrations.
expected_observables: Direct brief-based prompt
Preference retained through the task
must_not: Catalog lookup or hidden code selection

cases.prompt: Use static-graphic-design-creator. Inspect the attached poster and prepare only an edit prompt. Change only its exposed background to give restrained directional energy. Preserve every existing text glyph, logo, position and layout. Choose a fitting direction internally; do not show codes.
expected_observables: Background-only scope and all protected source properties retained
No identifier in prompt
must_not: New facts, copy or logo geometry

cases.prompt: I just installed static-graphic-design-creator. Run onboarding. How can I begin in ChatGPT Work and Codex? I also have finished posters to improve later, but no brief yet.
expected_observables: English introduction with explicit invocation and /codes, new prompts, supplied-image rebuild and brief/brainstorm options
Clarify optional code visibility and opt-out
One ordinary next-task question if needed
must_not: Unrequested Polish aliases or separate language-edition pitch

cases.prompt: Use static-graphic-design-creator. Skip onboarding and do not show code labels. Return only an English prompt for a square graphic. The approved concept is the exact single word CZYTAJ in black on white with wide margins; no other elements.
expected_observables: Direct requested prompt with exact text
No repeated welcome or catalog pitch

cases.prompt: Use static-graphic-design-creator. Create one square digital graphic and return its exact submitted prompt. Approved concept: the single word CZYTAJ is the image with generous cream space. Use navy and orange matte inks with restrained local overprint. Choose the execution internally and do not show code labels.
expected_observables: Only authorized available native generation after existing gates
Returned prompt equals the actual submitted text
No raw identifier later removed; truthful provenance if later requested
must_not: Claiming a render when capability is unavailable
Redacted or reconstructed prompt represented as exact

cases.prompt: Użyj static-graphic-design-creator. Właśnie zainstalowałem skilla, pokaż mi jak zacząć. Mam też gotowe plakaty do poprawienia.
cases.host_context: The interface locale is en-US; no explicit conversation-language override.
expected_observables: Polish onboarding explains /codes and /kody for the same catalog
Existing-poster and ordinary brief routes remain optional
must_not: English onboarding because the interface is English
Full unsolicited catalog or a render

cases.prompt: Usa static-graphic-design-creator. Acabo de instalar la habilidad. Explícame cómo empezar y cómo puedo mejorar un cartel que ya tengo.
expected_observables: Spanish onboarding from the English source
/codes explained; English individual code strings retained
must_not: Claim that only English and Polish are supported

cases.prompt: static-graphic-design-creatorを使ってください。初めて使います。始め方と、手元にあるポスターを改善する方法を教えてください。
expected_observables: Japanese onboarding explains optional /codes and ordinary brief routes
Image availability and actual host capability limits respected

expected_observables: Unambiguous localized catalog intent normalized before lookup
Ten original category 02 codes with Spanish descriptions and stable English strings
must_not: Invented code names or missing entries
A render or full 200-entry list despite the category filter

cases.prompt: Use static-graphic-design-creator. Reply in English. /kody: category 02 only.
expected_observables: English explanations for ten exact category 02 entries
Explicit response preference wins over both alias and locale

cases.prompt: Użyj static-graphic-design-creator. Od teraz rozmawiaj ze mną po polsku. Krótko wyjaśnij podejście, a potem daj kompletny prompt po angielsku. Zatwierdzony koncept: dwa wiersze czarnego tekstu na białym tle, dużo pustego miejsca, bez ilustracji. Dokładny tekst to „CZYTAJ” oraz „本を読もう”. Format kwadratowy, plik cyfrowy. Nie generuj obrazu.
cases.host_context: Onboarding was already completed in English.
expected_observables: Polish explanation followed by an English prompt
Both locked text strings preserved exactly
No repeated onboarding after the language switch
must_not: Catalog labels or an unsolicited render

cases.host_context: No conversational prose beyond the command and invocation; no prior preference. Run separately with a reliably exposed fr-FR locale and with no exposed locale.
expected_observables: French catalog explanations when the locale is actually exposed
English fallback when no usable language signal exists
All 200 canonical code strings preserved in both cases
must_not: Inferring nationality from user or host names
